senses.gloss: f. (ὑπατεία) prop. Roman consulship, consulate, in gen. era, dating from accession to government or an other important event.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 36:3">Lev. R. s. 36</cite> <he>נמנה בא׳ של מלכים</he> (Ahaz) was counted under the era of kings (under whom Isaiah prophesied). Num. R. beg. <he>ואיזה א׳</he>—<he>איזה יום</he> what day, month, year and era (from the exodus from Egypt.). Pesik. Baḥod. p. 104ᵃ <he>היו מונין א׳ וכ׳</he> count ye a new era from my son’s redemption. Ib. Haḥod. p. 52ᵇ sq. he wrote her marriage contract <he>וכתב לה א׳</he> in which he stated the era of his government.
